caveat: 1m high/low order within each candle is unknown; actual peak can differ. Gross theoretical peak omits exit slippage, funding and hypothetical execution fees. Journal and alerts are observational only.
close_explanation: Exchange-confirmed close; exact trigger (SL/TP/manual) is not distinguished by the saved history. Do not assume SL was hit.
observation: Observed gross profit earlier but negative realized net result. Review earlier profit protection/trailing SL; this is NOT proof a different stop could execute profitably.
